summary: Iter 47 referral / Founding Member / admin dashboard feature verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 13/14 PASS (1 SKIP due to placeholder slug). Frontend UI PASS for landing counter, register ?ref= flow (with localStorage persistence), profile ReferralSection (UTM channel switching + stats), public-profile founding badge, and admin Founding 100 + Referrals pages with filter clicks. Vehicle creation triggers qualify_referral_and_founding — invitee gains is_founding_member=true + founding_member_number, inviter.referral_count increments once. Second vehicle does NOT re-award (idempotency verified with 3rd vehicle).

GET /api/referral/my-code → {referral_code, referral_url containing code}. GET /api/referral/stats → total/qualified/contest_tickets=1+qualified/is_founding_member/founding_member_number. POST /api/referral/track returns 200 silently for invalid codes.
GET /api/community/founding-count (no auth) → registered=2, remaining=98, cap=100, is_full=false.

Admin endpoints (kontakt@sharago.com token): /api/admin/founding-members sorted by rank; /api/admin/referrals with qualified_only + pending_only filters; /api/admin/dashboard/stats includes founding_members, founding_cap=100, total_referrals, qualified_referrals.

GET /api/auth/me returns referral_code, referral_count, is_founding_member, founding_member_number; NEVER leaks password_hash. GET /api/users/invitee2 → card.user.is_founding_member=true, founding_member_number=1.
Landing / has [data-testid=founding-counter] with remaining='98', status text 'Program otwarty' (CSS uppercase → visually 'PROGRAM OTWARTY'), progress bar inline width:'2%'.

/register?ref=TESTREF&utm_source=facebook shows [data-testid=register-referral-notice] with 'Kod TESTREF' text and stores 'sharago_pending_ref'='TESTREF' in localStorage; subsequent /register visit without ?ref= still shows the notice from localStorage.

/profile ReferralSection: all 6 channel buttons (facebook/tiktok/instagram/whatsapp/email/friend) present; clicking tiktok updates [data-testid=referral-link-input] to include utm_source=tiktok, utm_medium=referral, utm_campaign=founding100, ref=<code>. Copy button + 3 stat cards (total/qualified/tickets=1) rendered.
/u/invitee2 shows [data-testid=founding-badge-compact] with text 'Founding #1' next to user name.

Admin (/gv91-admin): sidebar has admin-nav-founding + admin-nav-referrals between Marketplace and Forum. /gv91-admin/dashboard has admin-dashboard-founding-progress tile. /gv91-admin/founding renders admin-founding-bar, admin-founding-total='2', admin-founding-tbody with 2 rows. /gv91-admin/referrals renders ranking table (3 rows), 3 filter buttons (all/qualified/pending), items table (3 qualified rows after filter click).
critical_code_review_comments: referral.py:_generate_unique_code retries 12x then falls back to 'F' + secrets.token_hex(3)[:5] = 5 hex chars = 6-char code. That fallback path is NOT verified for uniqueness (no db lookup) — extremely unlikely but not strictly guaranteed unique. Consider one extra collision check on the fallback path.

referral.py:qualify_referral_and_founding reads count_documents({'is_founding_member': True}) then writes with $ne guard. Under concurrent first-vehicle creates two different users can compute the same rank; the $ne guard prevents double-awarding to the SAME user but NOT rank collisions between different users. In practice traffic is low, but a proper atomic counter (findAndModify on a counters doc) would be safer at scale. Given soft cap = 100 and low expected concurrency, acceptable for now.

Admin AdminLogin.js:25 forces navigation to /gv91-admin/change-password when first_login=true — good — but AdminLayout.js:26 only checks token presence, so a returning agent with a stored token bypasses the first-login guard entirely. If change-password is compliance-critical, the guard should be enforced in AdminLayout too. (Testing agent used this to enter panels without changing the seeded password.)

FoundingCounter.js emits Polish source string 'Program otwarty'/'Program zamknięty' and relies on CSS `uppercase` class for the review-request UPPERCASE spec — visually correct but any Playwright textContent check against 'PROGRAM OTWARTY' will fail. Consider hard-uppercasing the source string OR documenting that visual match is via CSS.
